cover.kick: Website guide for caterers and catering companies
cover.h1: A catering website that turns hungry browsers into booked tastings
cover.p: Ready-made, fast and built to be found on Google and AI assistants. Menu builder with allergens, instant quotes, office lunch ordering and planning tools included. We adapt it to your business, host it and keep it updated.

items: Your brand, Google and AI search
How we start and next steps
toc.demoP: Marigold & Thyme is a fictional catering company. Every name, dish, price, figure and review in the demo is a sample that we replace with your own.

glance.h: People booking a caterer want a menu and a price, fast
glance.p: A couple planning a wedding, an office manager ordering lunch or a family planning an Eid party all search Google, ask ChatGPT and compare caterers. They want to see the food, know what it costs per guest, and be sure you can handle their diets and allergies.
check: Does the food look good, and do you cook my kind of menu?
Roughly what will it cost per guest, with staff and VAT?
Can you handle halal, vegan and allergies safely?
Are you free on my date, and how easy is it to book?
give: A menu builder with 36 dishes, diets, allergens and a live price
An instant quote with staff, extras and VAT, line by line
A full allergen matrix and clear packages per guest
Online ordering for office lunches, with delivery slots
stats: Ready pages, including 6 service pages and 3 guides
Homepage styles: all events and weddings
Tools: menu builder, allergens, quote, tracker, food and staff calculators
Steps in the quote, from event type to booked consultation
for: Buffet, grazing table and platter businesses

home.p: One page that answers the three big questions: does the food look good, what will it cost, and how do I book.
s: Photo hero with instant price
A rotating arch photo, two buttons, rating and hygiene badges, and a live price check by event, guests and service style.
Six services
Photo cards for weddings, corporate, private chef, celebrations, BBQ and buffets, each with a price per guest.
One kitchen, three traditions
A printed-menu card that switches between British, South Asian and Mediterranean dishes, with diet badges.
Figures and process
Animated counters and four clear steps from first message to the last plate cleared.
Menu builder preview
A taste of the menu builder: dishes, price per guest and allergens.
Packages with a guest slider
Wedding, corporate and party packages; the slider shows the total for your guest numbers.
Gallery, reviews, office lunches, trust and FAQ
Recent events, a review carousel, an office-lunch promotion, hygiene and halal badges, answers and articles.
home.whyP: People choose a caterer with their eyes and their wallet. Big food photos build appetite, and a price in the first screen turns curiosity into an enquiry instead of a phone call to ask 'how much?'.

home2.p: Weddings are the biggest booking for caterers. This page speaks to couples and families directly, and is ideal for advertising, wedding fairs, Instagram and venue partnerships.
s: Wedding hero and price
A wedding headline, the instant price set to weddings and key figures.
Is your date free?
Couples pick a date and see how many catering teams are still free, with a button to hold it.
Packages and the day's timeline
Three wedding menus with totals for your guest numbers, and when each course goes out on the day.
Mehndi, nikah and walima
Separate menus for each event of an Asian wedding, plus couples' reviews and wedding FAQs.

services.p: An overview of everything you cater, plus a separate page for each service, written to answer the questions people search for.
a: Service cards
Photo, icon, price per guest and a short description.
Which service style?
A table comparing canapés, buffet, sharing and plated service: best for, price and staff needed.
b: Answer-first introduction
What the service is, who it is for, the starting price and when to book.
Sample menu
Six dishes in a printed-menu style, with diet badges and a link to the allergens.
Instant price and questions
The price check set to that event type, plus FAQs with structured data.
Related services
Three other services, so visitors keep exploring.

menus.h: Clients build their own menu, with every allergen shown
menus.p: The feature most catering websites don't have. Visitors choose dishes, see the price per guest change, and send the menu to you. Every dish shows its diets and the 14 UK allergens.
a: Filters
Course, diet (vegetarian, vegan, halal, gluten-free, dairy-free), free-from any of the 14 allergens, and a search.
Your menu tray
Dishes grouped by course, guests and service style, price per guest and total, all saved in the browser.
b: Allergen summary
The tray lists every allergen in the chosen menu. Download it or send it straight into a quote.
Allergen matrix
36 dishes by 14 allergens in one table. Hide any allergen or show only vegan or halal dishes.
menus.capA: Menu builder with halal filter and 7 dishes chosen
menus.capC: Allergen matrix, nuts and gluten hidden

quote.h: A quote that ends in a booked consultation
quote.p: Instead of a contact form, visitors answer five short steps. They see a line-by-line estimate before sending anything, and you get a qualified enquiry with every detail.
a: Event, date and guests
Five event types, date, guest slider, venue postcode and whether the venue has a kitchen. Pre-filled from service pages, packages and the menu builder.
Food and diets
Service style, the menu from the builder, vegetarian numbers, halal and allergies.
b: Live estimate
Food, menu supplements, staff (servers and chefs worked out from guests), extras, delivery and VAT.
Book the consultation
Phone, video or a tasting at your kitchen, with a date and time slot.
quote.whyP: Each step asks one easy question, so far more visitors finish than with one long form. Your team starts the call already knowing the date, guests, menu, diets and budget.

office.p: Regular corporate lunch orders are the steady income of a catering business. Office managers order platters, bowls and hot lunches in two minutes, without a phone call.
a: Menu with quantities
Each item shows how many it serves, its diets and the price, with + and − buttons.
Order rules built in
Minimum order, free delivery over a set amount, weekday delivery from tomorrow and time slots.
b: Postcode check
Only your delivery areas are accepted, with a clear message for others.
Order reference
A confirmation with a reference, and a 'repeat my last order' button for next time.
office.capB: Basket with delivery date, time and postcode

plan.h: Clear packages and the tools to plan with
plan.p: Clients want to know what they get for the money, and how much food and how many staff they need.
a: Package tabs and guest slider
Weddings, corporate and parties, three packages each, with the total for the visitor's guest numbers.
Food quantity calculator
Guests, hours, style and appetite give canapés, kilos of food, rice, naan, desserts, drinks and ice.
b: Staff calculator
Servers, chefs, bar staff and a manager for the guests and service style, with the staff cost.
Food timeline
When each course should go out, from the time guests arrive.

track.h: Clients follow their booking, and meet your team
track.p: After the quote, clients want to know what happens next. The tracker shows them, and the team and gallery pages show who will cook and serve.
a: Quote tracker
Enter the reference to see the proposal, tasting, deposits, final numbers and event day, with a calendar file.
Fewer 'just checking' calls
Clients see every date and amount without phoning.
b: Team profiles
Photo, role and story in a pop-up for each chef and manager.
Gallery
Filters by weddings, corporate, parties, outdoor and food, with a full-screen lightbox.
track.capC: Gallery with filters and a lightbox

more.h: Answers, articles and every way to reach you
faq: Visitors type a word and matching questions open with highlights. Topic filters and FAQ structured data.
blog: Guides on food per guest, wedding catering costs and allergens, written to be quoted by Google and AI assistants.
contact: Kitchen address, a map, hours, WhatsApp, phone and a short contact form with spam protection.
more.capBlog: Article: how much food per guest

items: A price range by event type, guests and style, before the visitor scrolls.
Searches dishes, services, office lunches, team, questions and articles (also Ctrl/Cmd + K).
Shows how many teams are free on the couple's date.
WhatsApp, call and mobile action bar
A WhatsApp button, tap-to-call and a Call / WhatsApp / Instant quote bar on phones.
Plain code, compressed images and quick loading on phones.
All content in one place: change a dish, an allergen or a package price once and every page updates.
feats.capCalc: Menu builder preview on the homepage

mobile.p: Most clients plan on their phone, often in the evening. The menu folds into a side drawer, the menu tray slides up from the bottom, and a bar keeps Call, WhatsApp and Instant quote one tap away.

search.p: The demo uses deep thyme green with marigold, Fraunces for headings and DM Sans for text: warm, appetising and trustworthy. We replace them with your logo, colours and food photos.
seo: A unique title and description on every page
FoodEstablishment, Service with price per guest, Menu with diets, FAQPage, Article and Breadcrumb structured data
A separate page for each service, plus menu, allergen and package pages
Sitemap, clean addresses and fast loading
geo: Guides with real quantities and prices that AI tools can quote
Consistent name, address and phone everywhere
An llms.txt summary of your services, menu and tools
search.qT: Searches the website is built around
search.whyP: More and more people ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Google AI which caterer to use and what catering costs. AI assistants quote sites with clear answers and consistent facts. We don't guarantee rankings or citations, but we report progress every month.

inc.h: Domain, hosting and email: we take care of it all
inc.p: The website arrives complete and ready to use. You never have to deal with anything technical.
items: A free .com, .net or .org domain with yearly billing, or we connect yours.
Reliable servers, SSL certificate (https) and regular backups.
Mailboxes on your own domain (e.g. hello@yourfirm.co.uk).
We keep the site updated and secure and make your changes.
Your Google Maps listing set up and linked to the website.
Privacy notice and cookie consent for your country.
inc.setupS: Delivered faster than a custom build
inc.monthS: Hosting, SSL and business email included
inc.yearS: 10 × the monthly fee, plus a free domain
inc.note: Ready Site prices for the Corporate Website package, November 2026. Prices in EUR, AED, PKR and other currencies on pentaservices.co.uk. 12-month minimum term from go-live.

start.h: What we need and what we do
need: Logo and colours, if you have them (otherwise we design them)
Business name, kitchen address, phone, email and areas you deliver to
Your menus with diets and allergens, and your packages and prices (or "on request")
Your best food and event photos
Office lunch menu and delivery rules, if you offer them
do: Adapt the design to your brand
Load your dishes, allergens and prices into the menu builder
Set up the quote, orders, forms and email
SEO, structured data and Google Business Profile
Test on phones, tablets and computers
Go live on your domain, then look after it
start.whyP: Every website is adapted to your business: your cuisines, menus, allergens, packages, delivery areas and team. The price model can use your real prices, show ranges or be hidden. For online payment we connect Stripe or PayPal. We send a clear proposal with no obligation.
